---
title: Section compression map
---

This map defines editorial choices for the thesis-derived publication draft.
The classifications are provisional and do not remove material from the thesis.

| Thesis material | Publication disposition | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `introduction.qmd`: multiaged management | Retain and condense | Establishes the silvicultural problem and retention-system context. |
| `introduction.qmd`: general sprout-development literature | Condense | Keep material needed to interpret the 10-year response; move broad developmental background out of the main narrative. |
| `introduction.qmd`: forest fuels and management effects | Merge and focus | Link fuels directly to the management setting and their value as reference conditions; avoid an independent fuels-trend narrative. |
| `methods.qmd`: site and study design | Retain | Essential to treatment interpretation and study reproducibility. |
| `methods.qmd`: detailed measurement protocols | Condense or supplement | Retain sampling units, timing, and variables; move implementation detail when it does not affect inference. |
| `methods.qmd`: regeneration and sprout analysis | Retain concisely | Needed for the primary regeneration findings. |
| `methods.qmd`: fuel analysis | Replace after specification | The publication must describe the final component definitions and summaries, not preserve a superseded pipeline. |
| `results.qmd`: basal area and sprout height | Retain and lead | Core evidence for the silvicultural question. |
| `results.qmd`: Douglas-fir counts | Supplement by default | Retain in the main text only if it changes the regeneration interpretation. |
| `results.qmd`: pre- and post-PCT fuels | Reframe | Present values and uncertainty as reference conditions; keep comparison tests only where they clarify a management mechanism. |
| `discussion.qmd`: regeneration | Retain and tighten | Connect overstory retention to cohort development with uncertainty stated plainly. |
| `discussion.qmd`: fuel loading | Reframe and tighten | Explain how the fuel dataset supports fire/fuels work without overemphasizing trends that are no longer the paper's central question. |
| `discussion.qmd`: limitations and future work | Retain selectively | Keep limitations that constrain inference or use of the reference values. |
| `tables.qmd`: model listings and full comparisons | Supplement | Preserve transparency while reducing main-text density. |

## Page-budget working guide

The current target is a manuscript of approximately 30 or more double-spaced
pages including main-text figures and tables. Until journal requirements are
applied, use this planning allocation: introduction 4–5 pages; methods 4–5;
results 7–9 including displays; discussion and conclusions 6–8; references and
front matter 4–6. Supplementary material is outside this working allocation.
